notes: Tested: a custom auth config created without `oauth_redirect_uri` sends `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add`. Register exactly the URI your auth config sends, or set `oauth_redirect_uri` to `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback` and register that instead.
Composio automatically requests the standard default scopes (`assets:read`, `cms:read`, `cms:write`, `sites:read`, etc.) during the redirect.

assumption: An agent that reads, writes, and manages content, custom code, forms, and pages across any customer's Webflow workspace.

verdict.headline: Webflow requires app registration via the Workspace settings and mandates a formal review process before public marketplace launch.
verdict.summary: Developers can self-serve register applications and test within their own developer workspace. Custom apps are initially restricted to the developer's workspace by default, and deploying to external users requires app review. Production scale requires handling API rate limits tied to user site plans.

handsOnEffort.label: 2–4 hours
handsOnEffort.basis: Configuring OAuth app in Webflow workspace and implementing endpoints.

timeToFirstConnection.label: 1–2 hours
timeToFirstConnection.basis: Immediate self-serve app creation under the developer workspace.

timeToProduction.label: 1–2 weeks
timeToProduction.basis: App review and approval timeline for external workspace access.

verdict.longestPole: App review and approval for marketplace or public workspace access.
verdict.costDetail: Webflow offers a free Developer Workspace plan for building and testing integrations, while site hosting and specific plans are billed separately.

easierPaths.condition: Private apps or internal workspace integrations
easierPaths.effect: Avoids public marketplace listing while still requiring the standard review submission process.

factors.detail: Developers can self-serve register applications in Workspace settings under Apps & Integrations.
Apps must undergo review before being available to external workspaces or the marketplace.
No explicit business verification documents or DUNS number required for standard developer registration.
No mandatory third-party security assessment or penetration test for basic data client integrations.
Developer workspace plan is free for building and testing integrations.
No partner program or sales contact required to register an app and develop.
Unapproved apps are restricted to the developer's own workspace by default, with up to 5 test user accounts requestable via support.
Customers authorize the application via standard OAuth flow without custom manual onboarding.

phases.title: Register your Webflow App
phases.outcome: An active Webflow application with a Client ID and Client Secret.

steps.title: Create a Developer Workspace
steps.details: Log in to Webflow and ensure you are using a workspace with Administrator access. Webflow provides a free Developer Workspace plan for building and testing integrations.

steps.title: Register the Application
steps.details: Navigate to **Workspace settings → Apps & Integrations**, select **App Development**, and create a new app using the **Data Client** building block.
steps.agentAssist: Draft a checklist of required app metadata such as app name, description, and website URL.

phases.title: Configure OAuth Settings & Redirect URIs
phases.outcome: Configured redirect URLs and credential securely generated.

steps.title: Configure Redirect URI and Scopes
steps.details: In your app configuration, set the redirect URI to `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add` (or `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback`). Select the necessary data and CMS scopes (`assets:read`, `cms:read`, `cms:write`, `sites:read`, etc.).
steps.agentAssist: Prepare the full list of required scopes for your integration agent.

steps.title: Retrieve Client ID and Client Secret
steps.details: Copy the generated Client ID. As a workspace administrator, view and securely copy the Client Secret. Store these credentials safely.

phases.title: Test with Your Own Account
phases.outcome: Verified authorization handshake using your developer workspace.

steps.title: Execute Test Authorization Flow
steps.details: Initiate an OAuth connection targeting `https://webflow.com/oauth/authorize` with `response_type=code` and verify that the authorization code is successfully returned and exchanged via POST to `https://api.webflow.com/oauth/access_token`.
steps.agentAssist: Run automated probe checks against Webflow's authorization endpoint to ensure parameters match requirements.

steps.title: Prepare App for Submission
steps.details: Ensure your app handles rate limits correctly (Starter/Basic: 60 RPM, CMS/Business: 120 RPM) and meets all Webflow Marketplace guidelines.
steps.agentAssist: Draft documentation, privacy policy statements, and scope justifications required for the review process.

phases.title: Go live in Composio
phases.outcome: Webflow fully wired into Composio for execution.

steps.title: Create Custom Auth Config in Composio
steps.details: Provide your Webflow Client ID and Client Secret to Composio via the developer dashboard or custom auth configuration API to enable managed execution for your Webflow toolkit.
steps.agentAssist: Generate the API payload needed to configure the custom OAuth2 integration inside Composio.

requirements.detail: A Webflow account with access to Workspace settings to create a new app under the App Development section.
Only workspace administrators are authorized to view a client secret in Webflow.
Configured callback URL (e.g., https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add) to receive authorization codes.

scopes.purpose: Read access to authorized user information
Read access to CMS collections and items
Write access to CMS collections and items
Read access to custom code configurations
Write access to custom code configurations

blockers.title: Client Secret Hidden
blockers.symptom: Cannot view the Client Secret in the Webflow dashboard.
blockers.howToProceed: Ensure you are logged into Webflow with Workspace Administrator permissions; non-admin users cannot view client secrets.

blockers.title: Authorization Code Expiration
blockers.symptom: Token exchange fails with an invalid or expired code error.
blockers.howToProceed: Webflow authorization codes expire in 15 minutes and can only be used once. Restart the authorization flow to obtain a fresh code.

blockers.title: External User Access Restriction
blockers.symptom: Users outside the developer workspace cannot install the unapproved app.
blockers.howToProceed: Unapproved custom apps are restricted to the developer's workspace by default. Request up to 5 test user accounts via Webflow support or submit the app for review.

nuances.title: Token Revocation
nuances.detail: Access tokens can be explicitly revoked by making a POST request to `https://webflow.com/oauth/revoke_authorization`.

nuances.title: Rate Limits by Plan
nuances.detail: Webflow API rate limits vary depending on the site plan: Starter and Basic plans allow 60 RPM, CMS, eCommerce, and Business plans allow 120 RPM, while Enterprise has custom limits.

nuances.title: PKCE Requirement
nuances.detail: Webflow supports and utilizes PKCE during the authorization code grant flow as implemented by Composio.

steps: Navigate to the Composio dashboard and open the Webflow toolkit configuration.
Select custom auth configuration and enter your Webflow Client ID and Client Secret.
Save the custom auth configuration and initialize a connection session.
